title: A Sound by the Shed
lines: It was a wet day at the start of the year.
Meg went out to the yard after the rain.
She could hear a small sound near the shed.
It was not clear at all. It was very small.
Meg felt a bit of fear and stood still.
Then the sound came back, like a cry.
"Dad, I hear a sound," she called.
Dad came out and said, "I am near, dear."
They went to the shed and looked all round.
Meg got down and held her ear near the grass.
The sound got more clear on that side.
It came from a big box of old pots.
Meg took the pots out one at a time.
At the bottom was a small wet pup.
It was stuck under a flat lid.
Meg tried to lift the lid, but it stuck fast.
So she tipped the box on its side.
Out came the pup, right on to her lap.
It licked her hand and her ear.
"You have good ears, dear," said Dad.
Meg has had that pup for a year now.

questions.ask: What was making the sound, and where was it?
questions.listenFor: A small pup, stuck under a lid in a box of old pots by the shed.

questions.ask: What did Meg try first to get the pup out, and did it work?
questions.listenFor: She tried to lift the lid. It stuck fast, so she tipped the box on its side.

questions.ask: What would you have done if you heard that sound? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any answer works. Listen for a because, not for bravery.
